node.statement: Left estimate: put D=P_{1,n}(XQ_{1,n}) and Y=XQ_{1,n}. By node 1.2, ||X-D||<=k_co e||X||. Submultiplicativity, ||P_n||,||P_{1,n}||,||Q_{1,n}||<=B, 1+epsilon<=2, the epsilon-associativity axiom, and node 1.1 give ||P_nX-X||<=||P_n(X-D)||+||P_n(P_{1,n}Y)-P_{1,n}Y||+||D-X||<=2Bk_co e||X||+[epsilon B^2+(1+epsilon)delta]||Y||+k_co e||X||. Since ||Y||<=2B||X|| and epsilon,delta<=e, this is at most [k_co(2B+1)+2B(B^2+2)]e||X||=Le||X||.
